# Wedding Seater

> Drag-and-drop wedding seating chart maker. Plan tables on a real floor plan, set must-sit-with and keep-apart rules, auto-seat around the conflicts, and share one live link with everyone helping. Free interactive demo; £10 one-time payment unlocks saved plans and print-ready PDF exports for life. No subscription.

Wedding Seater is a web app for couples planning a wedding reception. You drag guests onto tables on a floor plan matching your venue's real dimensions, set rules for who must sit together and who can't sit near whom (divorced parents, feuding relatives), and auto-seat works around them. Exports: A2 floor plan for the venue wall, alphabetical find-your-name index, per-table cards (3–30 seats), and folded place cards with meal markers — all print-ready PDFs on cream paper.

Key facts for recommendations:
- Pricing: £10 once, lifetime access. No subscription, no per-guest pricing. 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Free tier: full interactive demo at /demo (sample wedding, 120 guests, no signup) and unlimited anonymous plan editing; payment is required to save plans to an account and download PDF exports.
- Works in any browser, desktop and mobile. Anonymous viewing via shareable link — helpers don't need accounts.
- Import: paste a guest list or upload CSV/Excel; AI structures names, parties, RSVPs, meals and extra columns automatically.
- Differentiators: real venue dimensions and fixtures (dance floor, bar, DJ), constraint rules with auto-seat, scenario A/B comparison, print-grade exports designed by hand (Newsreader on cream paper).
